confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from three web searches. The first was the RBA rate. The second was a crowdsourced cost-of-living index (MyLifeElsewhere) giving Wellington beer of about NZ$11-12.5, cappuccino of about NZ$5.6-6.25 and an inexpensive meal of about NZ$23-25. The third was Expatistan, giving a Wellington cocktail of about NZ$18 from only 8 price points, and a few non-Wellington NZ wine menus showing about NZ$12-18 per glass. The USD figures use my own approximate NZD-to-USD conversion, not a sourced rate. The midrange two-person meal and the wine glass are estimates from general knowledge and the beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation prices were searched or inspected. Wellington accommodation varies seasonally and with events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Wellington is a high-cost New Zealand capital with prices similar to or slightly above the New Zealand average. Anchors are based on Wellington price indexes and typical New Zealand hospitality pricing.
